justifications.activity_coverage: None of the ground-truth processes or their steps are present; the reconstruction replaces them with unrelated, generic workflows.
justifications.control_flow_and_handoff_fidelity: The ground truth has ordered steps with explicit handoffs, while the reconstruction offers generic sequences with no meaningful handoffs, so the structural flow does not align.
justifications.attribute_accuracy: Tools, time estimates, and handoff targets from the ground truth are missing or empty, and step names don’t correspond, resulting in inaccurate or absent attributes.
justifications.exception_and_edge_case_capture: Ground-truth exceptions are specific per process with clear recoveries; the reconstruction lists generic issues and only loosely echoes two themes (missing info, ticket reassignment) without proper alignment.
justifications.faithfulness_no_hallucination: The reconstruction invents five generic processes and multiple steps not in the ground truth while omitting all expected content, indicating substantial hallucination.
